goal: Ensure deterministic AI operation over the bundle
description: Define canonical sources, deterministic read order, mandatory rules, and integrity expectations (README is not source of truth).
functional_rules: MUST read canonical DATA files first; MUST not invent IDs; mismatches in integrity files mean 'stale' not 'corrupt'.
acceptance_criteria: AI can locate canonical paths, validate presence/parse, and produce routine outputs following AI_QUERY_PLAYBOOK.
future_improvements: Add machine-readable schema registry under DATA/GOV (schemas index) and versioned playbooks.

feature: Data model reference (MER) and functional spec linkage
goal: Provide traceability from MER_AI tables to functional modules
description: MER_AI enumerates core entity groups and exported dictionary tables; SPEC_FUNC_AI maps them into functional modules and rules.
functional_rules: MER_AI is descriptive; SPEC_FUNC_AI is normative at functional level. Relations not captured in MER_AI must be marked PENDING.
acceptance_criteria: Each functional module lists the relevant entity groups/tables and explicit PENDING gaps when data is missing.
future_improvements: Extend MER_AI with RELATION records (FK-like) for core gameplay flows (chunk→dungeon→inner, etc.).

feature: World topology (regions, map types, chunks, dungeons, minidungeons, inners)
goal: Define exploration structure and navigation graph
description: Represent the world as regions containing chunks, with map types and nested structures (dungeon/minidungeon/inner).
functional_rules: All IDs must be unique and follow token policy; chunk graph must be connected per region unless explicitly isolated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chunk ID, AI can resolve its region, map type, adjacency, and available transitions to dungeon/minidungeon/inner.
future_improvements: Formalize quest gating and unlock rules over the world graph (requires QUEST tables).

goal: Provide story progression and presentation layers
description: Chapters define narrative milestones; cutscenes define scripted events; both must be traceable to world locations and conditions.
functional_rules: Cutscenes must reference canonical IDs for location/time and avoid duplication; maintain a single source per cutscene definition.
acceptance_criteria: AI can list chapters in order, associated cutscenes, and where they trigger (chunk/dungeon/inner).
future_improvements: Create QUEST/QUEST_STEP tables and link to chapters/cutscenes (PENDING).

goal: Define NPCs, types, and narrative/combat roles
description: NPCs have types/roles, appear in locations, and optionally act as quest givers, vendors, trainers, or enemies.
functional_rules: NPC IDs stable; types must exist before NPC instances; NPC placement must reference valid locations.
acceptance_criteria: AI can resolve NPC → type/role → location(s) and any linked dialogues/cutscenes where available.
future_improvements: Add NPC_DIALOG and NPC_SCHEDULE tables for richer behaviors and time-of-day patterns.

goal: Ground combat systems in deterministic data-driven taxonomy
description: Define monsters, monster types, and damage types to support combat balancing and encounter design.
functional_rules: Damage type list is closed set per build; monsters reference valid types; prefix policy enforced for monster IDs.
acceptance_criteria: AI can validate monsters: unique IDs, valid type/damage references, and consistent scaling rules.
future_improvements: Add encounter tables (ENCOUNTER, SPAWN_RULES) and drop tables (LOOT_TABLE) if missing.

goal: Define player progression and learn levels
description: Pericias/skills define capabilities; scaling tables map stats/levels to effects; learn-level tables define acquisition.
functional_rules: Scaling tables must define monotonic progression unless explicitly non-linear; learn-level references must resolve to existing skills.
acceptance_criteria: AI can compute/describe how a skill scales and at which level it is learned/unlocked.
future_improvements: Create unified SKILL_MASTER with stable IDs and localization fields; link to RMXP skills mapping.

goal: Drive world reactions and quest availability
description: Region-based reputation and hostility thresholds control NPC/faction behavior and unlock content post-events (e.g., post-goblin king).
functional_rules: Reputation level thresholds must be ordered; hostility derives from reputation + triggers; changes must be logged and testable.
acceptance_criteria: AI can list reputation levels per region and determine hostility state for a given reputation score.
future_improvements: Add event-driven reputation change log and quest unlock matrix.

goal: Support loot, crafting and progression
description: Armor dictionaries define defensive equipment and balancing parameters; must integrate with combat and crafting.
functional_rules: Equipment IDs stable; stats must map to derived attributes; ensure compatibility with RMXP item categories.
acceptance_criteria: AI can validate that armor entries have required fields and are compatible with damage/defense model.
future_improvements: Add WEAPON dictionary and ITEM_CATALOG normalization (if separate files exist).

goal: Provide player-driven item creation loops
description: Crafting uses workstations and recipes to produce items; access can be gated by locations, quests, or skills.
functional_rules: Each recipe must have inputs, outputs, and a workstation; gating rules must reference valid skills/locations.
acceptance_criteria: AI can list available recipes per workstation and validate that all referenced item IDs exist.
future_improvements: Add crafting unlock progression table and UI mapping for RMXP events.

goal: Enable content discovery, filtering, and mini-dungeon mechanics
description: Tags are used to classify content (chunks, minidungeons, etc). Puzzles define interaction mechanics and requirements.
functional_rules: Tag assignments must target existing entities and correct entity type; puzzle IDs stable and reference valid locations.
acceptance_criteria: AI can validate tag assignments for target type and list puzzles per location.
future_improvements: Create unified TAG_ASSIGNMENTS across all entity types with strict schema.

goal: Ground soundtrack mood and IP-safe inspiration
description: Use references as mood/texture guidance (Radiohead albums), without copying; track linkage to in-game contexts.
functional_rules: MUST be inspiration-only; no direct melodic copying. Use mood tags and contexts in references.
acceptance_criteria: AI can propose audio mood boards per chunk/dungeon based on reference tags and story beats.
future_improvements: Add AUDIO_CUES table mapping contexts → mood tags → reference IDs.

goal: Ensure project progresses toward playable build and Steam release
description: Define milestones: MER → Functional Spec → Technical Spec → Development → Local executable tests (Act 1) → Steam release (Act 4) → Post-release improvements.
functional_rules: Every homologated adjustment must record at least one log item and re-rank open backlog by WSJF.
acceptance_criteria: At any time, backlog top items reflect WSJF and next milestone can be derived from specs.
future_improvements: Create TECH_BUILD_SPEC (SPEC_TEC_AI) with RMXP build steps and Steam packaging checklist.

feature: Deterministic NPC personality + dialogue intent system
goal: Provide alive, consistent NPC behaviors and dialogue selection that is implementable in RPG Maker XP without heavy psych theory.
description: Defines 10 personality axes (0-100), fast-changing state variables, faction/culture norms, and a deterministic scoring contract for choosing dialogue variants per intent.
functional_rules:
Scene defines IntentID; NPC selects response by max(score) over candidate DIALOGUE_VARIANTS.
score = BaseScore + Σ(axis_value*AxisWeights) + Σ(state_value*StateWeights) + Σ(relation_value*RelationWeights) + Σ(norm_value*NormWeights).
Apply Effects: update NPC_STATE (stress/mood/fear), NPC_RELATIONS (trust/respect/debt), and MEMORY flags/events.
No free-text generation in engine; all outputs from catalogued variants.
acceptance_criteria: All new tables exist and are referenced in sheet_name_map.json; MER_AI updated with entity tables and relationships; NPC-0007 (Mago Louco) has explicit OutburstThreshold/Cooldown fields in NPC_PROFILE.
future_improvements: Implement RMXP RGSS runtime serializer (variables/switches) + debug overlay to inspect score components; add formal schema/validator registry for all tables.
notes: This is scaffolding; content expansion (full variants for Mago Louco) is tracked separately (AJ_000207).

goal: Allow the player to switch between walk and run on the map with a deterministic input modifier.
description: Holding the run key increases movement speed by a small delta. Optional run sprite suffix and optional footsteps; must degrade gracefully if assets are missing.
functional_rules: RUN key = Shift (fallback Input::A). Speed delta MUST be bounded. No crashes if run sprite/SE missing.
acceptance_criteria: New Game or loaded save: holding run key increases speed; releasing returns to walk. No crashes without _run sprite or step SE.
future_improvements: Externalize run config (key, speed delta) to a data table and expose in settings.
notes: Implemented by RM_MOVEMENT_RUN_RUNTIME; tied to AJ_000261.

feature: New Game creation: Class + Antecedente selection
goal: Before entering the world, force a deterministic selection of Class and Antecedente and persist it to save data.
description: On New Game, abrir UI de criação com listas canônicas (ACT1_CLASSES_CANON, ACT1_ANTECEDENTES_CANON) e filtro por ACT1_REL_CLASS_ANTECEDENTE_CANON.
functional_rules: Selection MUST occur before first map. Persist keys in save data. UI MUST have confirm/back and show short description.
acceptance_criteria: New Game abre criação; classe/antecedente exibem DisplayName canônico; lista de antecedente obedece REL; confirmação persiste rm_class_key/rm_antecedente_id; fallback seguro se CSV ausente (UI com defaults).
future_improvements: Automatizar teste de fluxo; aplicar loadout inicial; incluir localização/ícones na UI.
notes: Atualizado por AJ_000397 para ler CSV canônico em vez de listas hardcoded.

goal: Freeze Act 1 story/world scope while allowing implementation/system work to proceed safely.
description: Creates an explicit snapshot of the Act 1 content scope (IDs/contagens) and a QA report to detect drift.
functional_rules:
- Conteúdo do Ato 1 (story/world entities) não pode expandir (sem novos IDs/linhas) sem AJ dedicado.
- Mudanças permitidas: ajustes dentro de IDs existentes (texto, gates, notas, DoR/DoD, balance).
- Implementação pode expandir (scripts/UI/sistemas) desde que não adicione escopo narrativo/locações.
- Modo do freeze deve estar definido (STRICT/MILESTONE/OFF) e ser rastreável em QA.
acceptance_criteria:
- `RM_ACT1/DATA/CORE/ACT1_SCOPE_FREEZE_CANON.csv` existe e reflete snapshot.
- `RM_QA/DATA/QA/RPT_ACT1_SCOPE_FREEZE_STATUS.csv` existe e contém **0 ERROR**.
- Qualquer expansão de escopo requer AJ dedicado + updates em MER/SPEC/TRACE.
- `RM_QA/DATA/QA/RPT_ACT1_SCOPE_FREEZE_STATUS.csv` registra WARN se modo não for STRICT.
future_improvements: Automatizar comparação entre snapshots; bloquear PR/merge quando detectado drift; adicionar regra por 'story arc' e reputação.
notes: Added by AJ_000257.; Atualizado por AJ_000369 (política de modo).

goal: Garantir spawn tables determinísticas por bioma e chunks críticos
description: Mapear monstros canônicos em pools por MapType e overrides por ChaveMapa para viabilizar combate e balanceamento inicial.
functional_rules: Pools por bioma devem usar IDs canônicos e níveis coerentes com região; overrides prevalecem sobre pools globais; pesos somam distribuição amigável a early-game.
acceptance_criteria: QA pode listar encontros por bioma e chunk sem linhas vazias; RGSS carrega sem erro; chunks listados retornam pelo menos um monstro.
future_improvements: Adicionar variante por tempo do dia e raridade de loot (follow-up AJ_000427).

goal: Garantir que cada chunk crítico tenha loot mínimo determinístico alinhado ao early game.
description: Tabela canônica ACT1_LOOT_BY_CHUNK_CANON define itens e pesos por ChaveMapa; runtime consome via RM_Loot com fallback seguro.
functional_rules: Chunks-chave do prólogo (23T3) e vila (24S1) sempre retornam loot definido; tabela aceita múltiplos itens por chunk com pesos; ausência de linha resulta em lista vazia (sem crash).
acceptance_criteria: CSV contém ao menos uma entrada por chunk crítico; RGSS retorna itens ao chamar RM_Loot.loot_for_chunk; referências de ItemID existentes em ITENS_MASTER.
future_improvements: Adicionar loot por MapType e integração com nodes/monstros.
notes: Primeiro slice focado em cura/material seguro.
